title: Find a P104 short-cycle matching that survives the helper-91 screen
body:
## Summary
- Exhaustively enumerate simple alternating cycles of lengths 2–4 around the pinned PR3013 matching (3,375 total).
- Find three candidates with all 4,992 required support paths in the independent-contact relaxation.
- New cycle `[13, 203, 191, 63]` passes 33 of 9,765 exact nested-frame choices for helper 91; the package records one witness and the full census.
- The other 207 helpers remain relaxed, so this is a matching and one-helper result, not a realizable correction or κ improvement.

## Verification
- PASS: `python3 -I -B research/p104-alternating-cycle-neighborhood/verify.py` (CPython 3.14.7)
- PASS: `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-alternating-cycle-neighborhood --check-only`
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay was not run because Python 3.12 is unavailable in this environment.

## Credit and assistance
Reuses source-pinned routines from Nick Petalas’s PR3013/2996 lineage and the helper-91 flag checker from PR3032. OpenAI Codex prepared this contribution with user-directed research; no human mathematical review is claimed.
